title: Law to let parents request autism warning signs on streets
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to install a warning plaque alerting drivers to the presence of a child with autism, upon request by a parent or legal guardian. The agency would have to install the sign within two weeks of a verified request and would remove it once the child moves away, turns 18, or the family requests removal. The bill sets rules for prioritizing requests and determining sign placement.
